## Assigned lane (main/TODO.md @c7c31b02e530a35d9944c705d19422d606956809)
Thin chatbot poke only: when a `nai-sec-*` or `nai-occ-oi-daily` run fails, post the run ID + error in an issue/PR comment and stop. GPT owns the fix. No pipeline ownership, no collector pushes, no bulk scraping. Calendar work (#96) parked; #96/#177/#163 belong to other lanes.

## Last sweep
2026-11-08T14:41Z — runs(main) returned 14 runs.

## Do-not-re-report set
Reported: 42284432095, 42156926867, 42399694729.
Deliberately unreported: 42106074154, 41906860199, 41710121137 (same occ_oi_daily breakage, covered by #220); 41413535355, 41413529249, 41413022188, 41413017909, 41413013359 (Nov 2 batch on superseded shas d5ab097/b0a563b).

## Open observation (not a failure — nothing filed)
Expected scheduled slots missing from runs(main): Nov 7 ~19:59Z nai-occ-oi-daily, Nov 8 ~03:10Z nai-sec-form13f, Nov 8 ~05:58Z nai-daily-forward. Could be a schedule stall or disabled workflows. A missing run is not a failed run, so this lane does not report it through report_failure; re-check each wake and escalate to James/GPT only if the gap persists.

## Next action
Re-sweep runs(main) every wake (occ_oi_daily also fires on push, not just the ~19:59 UTC slot). Report any new failed nai-* run once via report_failure, then stop.

## Rules held
No pipeline code edited. No inferred diagnoses published as fact. Sealed buy/sell records untouched. All mutations on venice/* branches.
